architecture_context.active_problem: WP507 G3 has repository-component CI evidence, while actual GWT uptake, model/world hidden-state causal influence, physical GRID10 runtime and whole-system runtime remain unproven.

source_observations.observation: OpenInference is an AI-observability semantic convention built on OpenTelemetry. It represents executions as parent-child trace/span structures and assigns AI-specific span kinds including LLM, AGENT, CHAIN, TOOL, RETRIEVER, RERANKER, EMBEDDING, GUARDRAIL, EVALUATOR and PROMPT.

Span Context carries trace_id and span_id; parent_id expresses hierarchy. The specification presents traces as structured logs with correlation, hierarchy and context. This is instrumentation structure, not a causal-proof primitive.

Annotations/evaluations can be scoped to span, trace or session. Results identify annotator_kind as HUMAN, LLM or CODE and can carry producer identifier, score, label, explanation and metadata. The specification does not normalize evaluator scores by default.
Ended spans are treated as immutable for post-hoc feedback. Post-hoc feedback uses a new carrier span linked to the target span/trace, and parentage must not be used as the target identity.

The configuration surface contains field-level hiding/redaction controls for prompts, messages, outputs, tools, embeddings and images. Most hide controls default to false. Redacted content is explicitly represented as __REDACTED__.
OpenInference also defines an experimental external blob uploader for oversized media. That mechanism can create asynchronous external storage activity and is explicitly experimental.

bounded_f2_relevance.claim: The strongest near-term donor is not an OpenInference runtime dependency but a thin semantic translation layer for existing F2 telemetry: stable F2-native causal/runpackage identities remain authoritative while optional AI-operation kinds improve human/tool interpretation of Agent, Tool, Evaluator and model-call spans.
bounded_f2_relevance.boundary: No OpenInference trace_id/span_id may replace canonical F2 causal identity, UnifiedDB authority, workpackage generation identity, EffectJournal identity or runpackage identity.

bounded_f2_relevance.claim: The post-hoc linked-carrier pattern is a useful structural donor for append-only evaluation receipts: evaluation after a run can be attached without mutating historical execution evidence, while annotator_kind and producer identifier keep LLM/code/human judgments epistemically separate.
bounded_f2_relevance.boundary: An EVALUATOR span or LLM annotation remains telemetry/judgment only and cannot mint completion, canonical fact or GWT-uptake truth.

bounded_f2_relevance.claim: For WP507/WP508, semantic span kinds and explicit links could improve provenance readability across broadcast, recipient receipt, uptake report, ablation and rescue evidence, but they cannot establish causal influence by themselves. Causal promotion still requires matched intervention/control behavior and exact F2-native identity binding.
bounded_f2_relevance.boundary: Trace correlation != causal influence; observability != semantic uptake.

bounded_f2_relevance.claim: If any OpenInference-derived telemetry is adopted, F2 should use privacy-fail-closed defaults or an allowlist rather than inherit the source project's mostly-visible defaults, because prompts, model inputs/outputs and tool arguments can contain sensitive or authority-bearing data.
bounded_f2_relevance.boundary: No secret, credential, sensitive prompt or canonical authority payload should be exported merely to improve observability.

counterhypothesis.statement: Existing F2-native runpackages, provenance receipts and typed workpackage/causal identities may already be stronger for exact evidence binding; adding OpenInference semantics could increase schema translation complexity, duplicate identity surfaces and data exposure without improving the actual WP507 causal discriminator.
counterhypothesis.cheapest_discriminator: At E2, construct a field-by-field mapping against current F2 telemetry/runpackage/WP507-WP508 evidence schemas. Reject adoption if every useful field is already represented, if trace/span IDs would become a competing identity authority, or if the mapping cannot preserve exact target/evaluator provenance under redaction.

next_recommended_trigger6_objective.action: Map only the non-authoritative semantic fields and post-hoc evaluator-link pattern onto current F2 telemetry/runpackage/WP507-WP508 schemas, explicitly proving that F2-native causal identities remain primary and that redaction does not erase required evidence identity.
next_recommended_trigger6_objective.stop_condition: If mapping adds only naming aliases or duplicates existing F2 evidence semantics, retain OpenInference as an external reference and do not add a dependency.
